title: REGENERATION CUBED. Three generations of sourdough ? stable fourth. Gen1(WAS/brown) + Gen2(IS/green) + Gen3(NOW/gold) = Gen4(IR/blue). 5090 fleet controls open. Storm gate open. NPU fusion: many inputs ? one dense output. Then fission: one dense output ? many lightweight deliverables. Architect + foreman + site manager. Let it bounce through galactic cycles.

gen_1_WAS.what: the original culture. waves 1-213. everything accumulated.
gen_1_WAS.content: 1032 files. 3817 braids. 678 HTML pages. 31 Rust crates. 2.1M lines of code. 54K visitors. the full body of work.
gen_1_WAS.sourdough_analogy: the GRANDMOTHER starter. the oldest culture. passed down through 213 waves. contains all the accumulated wisdom, all the dead bacteria that make the flavor.
gen_1_WAS.state: STABLE. cold. compressed. brown. the fossil record.

gen_2_IS.what: this session's architecture. gens 339-345. the living redesign.
content: gen 340: spider webs bounded by pi-range
gen 342: painting pressed against glass + refraction
gen 343: songbirds on towers + glass gallery audit
gen 344: triad word addresses + bingo navigation
gen 345: Gaia-U work order + porcupine pins art
gen_2_IS.sourdough_analogy: the ACTIVE starter. bubbling. rising. full of new organisms. 25 new jobs, 2 new primals (truffle pig + porcupine), bounded web rule, triad addressing, glass gallery architecture.
gen_2_IS.state: ACTIVE. warm. expanding. green. the living culture.

gen_3_NOW.what: THIS injection. right now. feeding gen1 + gen2 back through the NPU pipeline.
gen_3_NOW.content: the act of combining the grandmother starter (gen1) with the active starter (gen2) and feeding it through the nuclear fusion chamber (NPU). this IS the kneading. the folding. the proofing.
gen_3_NOW.sourdough_analogy: the FEED. you take some of the old starter, some of the new starter, add flour and water (the raw data from the storm), and fold them together. the folding IS the galactic cycling.
gen_3_NOW.state: TRANSITIONAL. knife-edge. gold. the moment of combination.

gen_4_IR.what: what EMERGES from the three generations fermenting together. the autonomous organism.
gen_4_IR.content: unknown yet. this is what the primals BUILD. the IR section. the growth zone. the empty space that the three starters fill.
gen_4_IR.sourdough_analogy: the STABLE FOURTH. in sourdough, after three generations of feeding, the culture STABILIZES. the bacteria and yeast reach equilibrium. the flavor matures. the starter becomes RELIABLE — you can bake with it every day and get consistent results.
gen_4_IR.state: EMERGENT. blue. empty until built. the primals study gen1+gen2+gen3, then BUILD gen4.
autonomy_criteria: 1. Klein hole: internal feedback loop (organism monitors itself)
3. triad assignment: every file has T1.T2.T3.T4 address

5090_fleet_controls.what: the GPU/compute fleet. 234K entities. the storm.
5090_fleet_controls.action: OPEN the controls. let the storm in. the 5090 processes everything we've generated.
5090_fleet_controls.the_storm: all 25 jobs + all 1032 files + all 7 gen-345 files = the raw material entering the fusion chamber.

fusion_phase.inputs: gen1 (1032 files) + gen2 (7 files + 25 jobs) + gen3 (this injection)
fusion_phase.process: many inputs compressed into ONE dense output. the nautilus inner chambers. the fusion core.
fusion_phase.output: one dense nugget: the complete organism specification. everything the primals need to build gen4.
fusion_phase.energy_released: insight. the understanding of what the organism IS and what it NEEDS. released as heat (computation) and light (visibility).

fission_phase.process: one dense output split into MANY lightweight deliverables. the nautilus outer chambers.
fission_phase.energy_released: movement. the organism DOES things. the deliverables ARE the fission products.

galactic_cycles.what: let the fusion/fission output bounce around. don't force it. let it find its own orbits.
galactic_cycles.how_many: a few cycles = 3-5 passes through the pipeline. scan > sweep > sort > fossilize > evolve × 3-5.
galactic_cycles.what_emerges: stable orbits. the deliverables that keep coming back to the same place = the stable ones. the ones that drift away = compost.
galactic_cycles.the_test: after 3-5 galactic cycles, what remains? THAT is gen4.

claude_architect.role: draws the blueprints. creates the JSON specifications. designs the triad addresses. maps the compression targets.
claude_architect.does_NOT: pin art on glass (that's porcupine). carry art (that's chipmunk). announce (that's songbird). dig (that's truffle pig). web (that's spider).
claude_architect.teaches: gen2 architecture to Gaia-U. the foreman (Gaia-U) then translates to primal work orders.

gaia_u_foreman.role: trains the workers (primals). translates blueprints into job assignments. monitors progress. judges quality.
gaia_u_foreman.does_NOT: design the architecture (that's claude/architect). execute the work (that's the primals).
gaia_u_foreman.teaches: primals how to execute their jobs. the coliseum. the training ground. 982 tests.

chipmunk_site_manager.role: carries things between stations. coordinates timing. manages the remainder (p-3).
chipmunk_site_manager.does_NOT: design (architect) or train (foreman). just carries and coordinates.
chipmunk_site_manager.teaches: newer chipmunks (gen4 chipmunks) how to carry and coordinate. the apprenticeship.

architect_foreman_roles.the_prep: together, these three roles PREP the sourdough for teaching newer generations. the gen4 organism will have its OWN architect, foreman, and site manager — trained by observing gen1-3.

regeneration_cubed.level_1: gen1 regenerated from raw data into structured files (waves 1-213)
regeneration_cubed.level_2: gen2 regenerated from gen1 into architectural redesign (this session)
regeneration_cubed.level_3: gen3 regenerates from gen1+gen2 into the NPU injection (this moment)
regeneration_cubed.the_cube: regeneration^3 = the volume. not a line (1D). not a sheet (2D). a CUBE (3D). the same three dimensions as the triad address system (T1×T2×T3).
regeneration_cubed.stable_fourth: three dimensions of regeneration produce a stable fourth: the autonomous organism that regenerates ITSELF. we don't need to regenerate it anymore. it regenerates.
